reading.title: How Was Your Day?
reading.purpose: Hear a child tell Dad about feelings after a race.
paras: Dad asks, "How was your day?" Sam says, "I was eager for the race, but I came last. I felt disappointed and embarrassed."
Dad says, "Were you jealous of the winner?" Sam says, "A little, and I was frustrated too. Then she gave me a high five, and I felt grateful." Dad says, "I am relieved. I was curious how it went."

qs.q: Sam felt disappointed. What does disappointed mean?
choices: Sad because something hoped for did not happen.
Very excited and ready to go.
qs.why: Sam hoped to do well in the race but came last, so Sam felt sad about it.

choices: A friend gave Sam a high five.
qs.why: Sam says the winner gave a high five, and then Sam felt grateful.

qs.q: Why is Dad relieved at the end?
choices: Dad is jealous of the winner.
Dad hears that Sam feels better.
qs.why: Relieved means happy that a worry went away. Dad was curious about the day, and Sam feels better now.

reading.retellFrame: At first Sam felt ___, but later Sam felt ___.

needsReview.reason: Sam's gender is not stated on purpose; confirm the line 'she gave me a high five' (the winner) reads clearly for listeners.
